title: A battle facility's trainer: data/facilities/<facility>/trainers/<trainer>.json
description: A trainer of a facility's trainers archive: its class and the sets it picks its Pokémon from, with its name and messages, which the text takes. tools/data/facility_data.py packs them in the order of the facility's order.json. A string value is the name of a constant from data/constants/ or include/constants/.

name.description: The trainer's name. The trainers with names come first; the facility's last trainers may have none

class.description: The trainer's class. A Pokémon World Tournament trainer has unk0 instead

unk0.description: In the Pokémon World Tournament's pools, the field the other facilities have the class in: 2 for every trainer but the first; the tournaments' trainers come from elsewhere

pokemon.description: The sets the trainer picks its Pokémon from, by name, of the facility's pokemon/

single_set.description: For the Pokémon World Tournament's trainers, the one set the trainer brings when the entrant's unk0_7 is set (func_ov134_021f0258), from the pool's first archive

messages.description: What the trainer says, with their line breaks: as many as the facility has for each trainer, for the trainers with names
